text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. High-end stylized 3D fairytale conservatory environment, sculpted ivory arches, blackberry-purple velvet curved seats, rose-gold botanical trellises, crystal-clear greenhouse roof and pale blossoms, polished but tactile velvet and frosted glass, gentle cinematic bounce light, richly elegant palette, no statues or human imagery.
